row: Biohacking For Dogs with Dr Dan Beatty

Created by holistic veterinarian, Dr. Dan Beatty, this channel is dedicated to improving your dog’s life through biohacking techniques. Discover tips on nutrition, mental health, and innovative therapies designed to enhance your dog’s well-being. Whether you’re looking to boost their physical fitness or mental sharpness, our approach focuses on helping your canine companion thrive in every aspect of their life.
